caption: Sienelės storis, mm. / Teorinis metro svoris (kg/m).
notes: Cinkuoti vandens dujų vamzdžiai, EN 10255 + EN 10240. Value cells = theoretical weight in kg/m; the only label column is the outside diameter in mm - this table has NO DN column (neither in the header strip nor in the body); wall-thickness column labels in mm. 11 rows x 10 columns (1 label + 9 value columns): 47 filled value cells, 52 empty; the filled/empty pattern is identical to the black 'vandens-duju' table. All decimals are printed with a dot and two decimals. Every printed value equals the black-tube value of the 'vandens-duju' table multiplied by 1.07 (zinc coating allowance) to within 0.01, i.e. they are intentionally about 7 % above the bare-steel formula (D-t)*t*0.0246615. SOURCE ANOMALY, transcribed as printed and NOT corrected: row 42.4 / column 4.0 is printed 4.25 (= 3.97 x 1.07; it inherits the probable 3.97-instead-of-3.79 typo of the black table; 3.79 x 1.07 would be about 4.06). 4.25 is therefore printed twice: row 42.4 / column 4.0 and row 48.3 / column 3.6. All other cells are within 1.4 % of formula x 1.07. Reading method: each cell was read visually at about 5x enlargement and, independently, decoded by pixel-exact glyph matching; both readings agree on every cell. Cell positions were taken from the vertical grid lines of the body (x = 185, 280, 375, 470, 565, 660, 755, 850, 945 px), which line up with the header labels.
